responsibility: This source file implements the helper logic and guard predicates referenced by the NDS32 pipeline automata. It analyzes insn RTL to classify loads, stores, post-update addressing, multiword memory micro-operations, movd44/divmod peculiarities, branch operands, and producer/consumer register overlaps, then answers the bypass-condition functions declared in nds32-protos.h for N7/N8/E8/N9/N10/Graywolf/N13 scheduling descriptions.
